changes.text: Third, how he kept the books after it worked. Zhao was about to grant five cities; a retainer reminded him that he could not count as a loyal minister to Wei, and he blamed himself on the spot. Before the king of Zhao he declared he had failed Wei and done nothing for Zhao. While he was staying in Zhao he still said he had failed his king to save Zhao. On this reading he did not write the debt off: the army went home to Wei, and he stayed in Zhao. But the record also says he stayed in Zhao ten years without returning; when the king of Wei sent men to fetch him, he feared the king's anger and even barred his household from admitting the king's envoys, so staying there need not mean he was owning up to the debt.
第三步是事成之后怎么记账。赵要封五城，门客提醒他对魏算不得忠臣，他立刻自责；在赵王面前自言负魏、无功于赵；留赵期间还说自己负魏王而救赵。作者推断：从这些言行看，这笔债他没有抹掉，军队送回魏国，自己留在赵国。不过原文也写，他留赵十年不归；魏王遣使来请，他怕魏王发怒，还禁止门下为魏使通报，留赵未必就是认下这笔债。

King Xiaocheng of Zhao, grateful that Wuji had seized the army on a forged order and saved Zhao, took counsel with Lord Pingyuan and proposed to enfeoff him with five cities. When Wuji heard, he "showed a self-satisfied look, as if the credit were his own." A retainer came to him: kindness done to you must never be forgotten, he said; kindness you do to another is best forgotten. Forging the king of Wei's order and seizing Jin Pi's army — "toward Zhao you have done a service; toward Wei you cannot be called a loyal minister." To go on preening yourself over it is something I cannot approve. Wuji "at once blamed himself, as if there were nowhere he could hide." Later, when the king of Zhao received him with the rites of a host, Wuji stood to the side, declined the honor, and pronounced himself at fault, saying he had failed Wei and done nothing for Zhao. Because Wuji held back, the king of Zhao could not bring himself to hand over the five cities. In the end the king gave him the town of Hao to support his household, and Wei restored to him the city of Xinling.

赵孝成王感激他矫令夺兵而存赵，与平原君商量，要拿五座城封给他。无忌听说，「意驕矜而有自功之色」。一位门客劝他：别人对你有德，不可忘；你对别人有德，最好忘掉。矫魏王令、夺晋鄙兵，「於趙則有功矣，於魏則未為忠臣也」，还自骄自功，我私下以为不可取。无忌「立自責，似若無所容者」。后来赵王以主人之礼相迎，无忌侧身辞让，自言有罪过，「以負於魏，無功於趙」。赵王因他退让，口不忍献五城，最后把鄗给他作汤沐邑，魏国也把信陵还给他。

dispositions.rationale: 英文末句的 settling the debt（还清债务）改为 owning up to the debt（承认亏欠），与中文“认下这笔债”及同段 did not write the debt off 的框架一致；中文不变，按同步规则一并给出全文。

evidence.quote: 公子恐其怒之，乃誡門下：「有敢為魏王使通者，死。」

dispositions.rationale: 原文是史家的间接叙述，不是无忌的原话。英文把带引号的第一人称直接引语改为间接转述 saying he had failed Wei and done nothing for Zhao。中文引的是逐字片段，保持不变，按同步规则一并给出全文。

evidence.quote: 自言罪過，以負於魏，無功於趙
